enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with the fan running for air circulation
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Close eyes. Turn onto the left side. Place the arm under the pillow. Turn the head to the right. Turn onto the back. Stretch both legs. Pull the blanket up to the chest. Turn onto the right side. Bend the knees. Place one hand under the cheek. Remain lying still. Turn the head to the left. Shift the pillow with one hand. Turn onto the back again. Move the arm to the side of the body. Remain lying in the bed until the alarm.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom. Open the bathroom door. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Cup both hands under the water. Splash water onto the face. Turn off the tap. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush teeth. Rinse the mouth with water. Spit into the sink. Put down the toothbrush. Turn on the shower tap. Step into the shower. Wet the hair and body. Apply soap. Rub the arms, chest, and legs. Rinse the body under the water. Turn off the shower tap. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face. Wipe the hair. Wipe the body. Hang the towel on the rack. Open the bathroom door. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with kettle and toaster, having tea and toast
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the bread. Take out the milk. Close the refrigerator door. Put the bread slices into the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Fill the kettle with water from the tap. Place the kettle on the base. Press the kettle switch on. Open the cabinet door. Take out a mug. Take out a plate. Close the cabinet door. Place the mug on the counter. Place the plate on the counter. Put a tea bag into the mug. Pour hot water from the kettle into the mug. Take the toast out of the toaster. Place the toast on the plate. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the butter. Close the refrigerator door. Spread butter on the toast with a knife. Sit down at the table. Pick up the mug. Take a sip of tea. Put down the mug. Pick up the toast. Take a bite. Chew and swallow. Take another bite of the toast. Pick up the mug again. Drink the tea. Put down the mug. Stand up. Carry the plate and mug to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and checking phone for the day's work schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a shirt. Take out trousers. Close the wardrobe door. Take off the sleepwear. Put on the shirt. Button the shirt. Put on the trousers. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Sit down on the bed. Pick up the phone from the bedside table. Press the power button. Unlock the screen with a swipe. Open the calendar app. Scroll through the day's schedule. Read the meeting times. Tap on the first event. Close the calendar app. Press the power button to lock the screen. Put the phone into the bag. Stand up. Pick up the bag. Walk out of Bedroom 1.

Walk out of the house. Close the front door. Walk along the sidewalk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the bag. Check the bus arrival time on the phone. Put the phone back into the bag. Step onto the bus. Tap the transit card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit down on a seat. Place the bag on the lap. Look out of the window. Stand up when the stop is announced. Walk to the rear door. Step off the bus. Walk along the street. Cross at the crosswalk. Walk to the office building entrance. Push the door open. Walk to the elevator. Press the elevator button. Step into the elevator. Press the floor button. Step out of the elevator. Walk to the desk. Put the bag down on the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit as community program coordinator, running program planning and partner calls
enriched_activities.desc: Sit down at the desk. Open the bag. Take out the laptop. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Log in with the password. Open the email client. Read the new emails. Open the calendar. Review the morning meeting list. Pick up the notebook. Write down the program agenda. Pick up the phone. Dial the first partner number. Speak into the phone about the program schedule. Write notes on the notepad while listening. End the call. Put down the phone. Open the project document on the laptop. Type the program plan. Open the spreadsheet. Enter the volunteer numbers. Save the file. Stand up. Walk to the printer. Pick up the printed pages. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Staple the pages together. Pick up the phone. Dial the second partner. Discuss the meeting date and venue. End the call. Type the meeting notes into the document. Save the document. Open the email client. Attach the document. Type the recipient address. Click send.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the desk. Push the chair in. Walk out of the office. Walk along the street to the restaurant. Open the restaurant door. Walk to the counter. Read the menu board. Order a lunch set. Pay with the phone. Take the receipt. Walk to a table. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the chopsticks. Pick up the bowl. Eat the rice. Pick up the vegetables with the chopsticks. Chew and swallow. Pick up the cup. Drink water. Put down the cup. Continue eating the main dish. Finish the meal. Put down the chopsticks. Stand up. Push the chair in. Walk out of the restaurant. Walk back to the office building.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work on community program coordination, preparing materials and meeting with volunteers
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the desk. Sit down. Open the laptop. Press a key to wake the screen. Unlock the screen. Open the material template. Edit the content. Insert images into the document. Save the file. Open the printer dialog. Print the materials. Stand up. Walk to the printer. Pick up the printed materials. Walk to the meeting room. Place the materials on the table. Arrange the chairs around the table. Walk back to the desk. Pick up the phone. Send a message to the volunteers about the meeting time. Put down the phone. Pick up the notebook. Walk to the meeting room. Stand at the front of the room. Greet the volunteers. Distribute the materials. Sit down at the table. Explain the program plan. Point at the printed schedule. Listen to the volunteers' questions. Write the answers on the whiteboard. Stand up. Hand out the sign-up sheet. Collect the filled sheets. Thank the volunteers. Walk the volunteers to the door. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Open the laptop. Type the meeting summary. Save the file.

Close the laptop lid. Put the laptop into the bag. Stand up. Push the chair in. Pick up the bag. Walk to the elevator. Press the elevator button. Step into the elevator. Press the ground floor button. Step out of the elevator. Walk out of the office building. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the bag. Check the bus arrival time. Put the phone back into the bag. Step onto the bus. Tap the transit card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit down on a seat. Place the bag on the lap. Stand up at the stop. Walk to the rear door. Step off the bus. Walk along the sidewalk. Walk to the house. Open the front door. Step inside. Close the front door.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner using the induction cooker and oven
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables. Take out the meat. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Turn on the tap. Rinse the vegetables under the water. Turn off the tap. Place the vegetables on the cutting board. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables into pieces. Put the knife down. Open the cabinet door. Take out a pot. Close the cabinet door. Place the pot on the induction cooker. Press the induction cooker power button. Pour oil into the pot. Put the vegetables into the pot. Pick up the spatula. Stir the vegetables. Put down the spatula. Press the oven button to preheat. Open the oven door. Place the meat tray into the oven. Close the oven door. Set the oven timer. Stir the vegetables again. Press the induction cooker button off. Take a plate from the cabinet. Scoop the vegetables onto the plate. Open the oven door. Take out the meat tray. Close the oven door. Place the meat on the plate. Carry the plate to the table. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the chopsticks. Eat the vegetables. Eat the meat. Chew and swallow. Put down the chopsticks.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table, washing up, and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the chair. Pick up the plate. Carry the plate to the sink. Pick up the chopsticks. Carry the chopsticks to the sink. Pick up the cups. Carry the cups to the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the plate under the water. Rinse the chopsticks. Rinse the cups. Turn off the tap. Open the dishwasher door. Pull out the lower rack. Place the plate into the rack. Place the chopsticks into the basket. Place the cups into the upper rack. Push the rack in. Close the dishwasher door. Press the dishwasher start button. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the table surface. Wipe the counter. Rinse the cloth under the tap. Turn off the tap. Wring the cloth. Hang the cloth on the hook. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV with the air conditioner on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Pick up the air conditioner remote. Press the power button. Press the temperature down button. Put down the remote. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the TV remote. Press the power button. Press the channel button. Put down the remote. Lean back on the sofa. Watch the TV screen. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Unlock the screen. Scroll through the messages. Tap a message to reply. Type a reply. Send the message. Lock the screen. Put down the phone on the sofa. Pick up the TV remote. Press the volume up button. Put down the remote. Watch the TV. Stand up. Walk to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out a bottle of water. Close the refrigerator door. Walk back to the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Open the bottle cap. Drink water. Close the bottle cap. Put down the bottle on the table. Pick up the TV remote. Press the power button to turn off the TV. Pick up the air conditioner remote. Press the power button off. Put down the remote. Stand up. Walk out of the living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and completing night hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Open the bathroom door. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the water heater switch. Turn on the shower tap. Step into the shower. Wet the hair and body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Pour shampoo into the palm. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap on the body. Rinse the body under the water. Turn off the shower tap. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel. Wipe the hair. Wipe the face. Wipe the body. Wrap the towel around the body. Turn on the tap. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush teeth. Rinse the mouth. Spit into the sink. Turn off the tap. Put down the toothbrush. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel on the rack. Turn off the bathroom light. Turn off the water heater switch. Open the bathroom door. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and reviewing tomorrow's program notes on the computer with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe door. Take out the sleepwear. Close the wardrobe door. Take off the clothes. Put on the sleepwear. Sit down on the chair at the desk. Turn on the desk lamp switch. Pick up the computer. Open the lid. Press the power button. Log in with the password. Open the program notes file. Scroll down the page. Read the notes. Pick up the pen. Write notes in the notebook. Put down the pen. Continue reading the file. Scroll up the page. Open the second document. Read the volunteer list. Type a comment into the file. Save the file. Close the document. Close the computer lid. Press the desk lamp switch off. Stand up. Pick up the notebook. Place the notebook on the bedside table. Pick up the phone. Unlock the screen. Set the alarm. Lock the screen. Place the phone on the bedside table. Walk to the bed. Pull back the blanket. Lie down on the bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with the fan running for air circulation
enriched_activities.desc: Press the fan power button. Adjust the fan speed switch. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Place the arm under the pillow. Close eyes. Turn onto the left side. Bend the knees. Turn onto the back. Move the arm to the side. Turn onto the right side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulder. Turn the head to the left. Shift the pillow with one hand. Turn onto the back again. Remain lying still in the bed.
